invention.quote: mixed with the pulp of <term>kapittha</term> <gloss>wood-apple</gloss> fruit

defects.detail: 'pulp of kapittha (wood-apple) fruit' for source 'सजडाफलान्'; reference has seeds of Mucuna pruriens (jaḍā = ātmaguptā)
'a generous amount of buffalo meat broth' drops the ghee of 'घृताढ्य माहिषरसे' (reference: 'enriched with ghee')
'Season the mixture with coriander, cumin, and dry ginger' drops 'मावया युक्तो' (reference: 'each of proper measure')

invention.quote: <gloss>a species of small carp, Puntius sophore</gloss>
<note>a variety of rice that matures in sixty days</note>

defects.detail: 'water chestnuts jaḍāphala (Trapa natans)' for source 'सजडाफलान्'; reference has seeds of Mucuna pruriens

reason: Both misidentify 'सजडाफलान्' (reference: Mucuna pruriens seeds) — T1 as wood-apple pulp, T2 as water chestnut — and both follow the OCR 'मिष्टान्' as 'sweet'; T1 additionally drops the ghee of 'घृताढ्य माहिषरसे' and the 'proper measure' of the spices in v. 8, which T2 keeps; vv. 9-11 and the final māṣa/ātmaguptā line agree with source and reference in both.
